  if (state.triggerCalendarUpdate) {
    const dayNum = state.currentDay;
    
    // 1. Calculate Exact Date and Month
    const months = [
      { name: "April", days: 30 }, { name: "May", days: 31 }, { name: "June", days: 30 },
      { name: "July", days: 31 }, { name: "August", days: 31 }, { name: "September", days: 30 },
      { name: "October", days: 31 }, { name: "November", days: 30 }, { name: "December", days: 31 },
      { name: "January", days: 31 }, { name: "February", days: 28 }, { name: "March", days: 31 }
    ];
    
    let remaining = dayNum;
    let currentMonth = "";
    let currentDate = 1;
    
    for (let m of months) {
      if (remaining <= m.days) {
        currentMonth = m.name;
        currentDate = remaining;
        break;
      }
      remaining -= m.days;
    }

    const daysOfWeek = ["Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"];
    const dow = daysOfWeek[(dayNum - 1) % 7]; 

    // 2. Determine Current Term
    let currentTerm = 1;
    if (dayNum >= 285) {
      currentTerm = 3; 
    } else if (dayNum >= 154) {
      currentTerm = 2; 
    } else if (dayNum >= 11) {
      currentTerm = 1; 
    }

    // 3. Check Events and School Status
    let isSchoolClosed = (dow === "Sunday"); 
    let activeEvents = [];
    let upcomingEvents = [];

    events.forEach(e => {
      if (dayNum >= e.startDay && dayNum <= e.endDay) {
        activeEvents.push(e);
        if (e.closed) isSchoolClosed = true;
      } else if (e.startDay > dayNum) {
        let diff = e.startDay - dayNum;
        if (diff <= e.notice) {
          // Check if this is the very first day the notification pops up
          let isAnnouncement = (diff === e.notice && e.notify);
          upcomingEvents.push({ name: e.name, diff: diff, announce: isAnnouncement });
        }
      }
    });

    // CHECK FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR BREAKS
    let isMajorBreak = activeEvents.some(e => 
      ["Spring Break", "Summer Break", "Winter Break"].includes(e.name)
    );

    // CHECK FOR HOLIDAYS THAT OVERRIDE BREAKS (Any closed event that ISN'T the break itself)
    let isHolidayOverride = activeEvents.some(e => 
      e.closed && !["Spring Break", "Summer Break", "Winter Break"].includes(e.name)
    );

    // 4. Construct the Calendar Text
    let calText = `Current Date: ${dow}, ${currentMonth} ${currentDate}\n`;
    
    // DETERMINE TODAY'S SUBJECTS
    let todaySubjects = "";
    if (isHolidayOverride) {
      todaySubjects = "None"; // Special holidays override the break schedule
    } else if (isMajorBreak) {
      todaySubjects = "Extracurricular"; // Standard break day
    } else if (isSchoolClosed) {
      todaySubjects = "None"; // Standard Sundays
    } else {
      todaySubjects = schedules[currentTerm][dow]; // Normal school day
    }
    
    calText += `Today's Periods: ${todaySubjects}\n`;

    // Append active events
    activeEvents.forEach(e => {
      if (e.startDay === e.endDay) {
        calText += `${e.name} today\n`;
      } else {
        let daysLeft = e.endDay - dayNum;
        let status = daysLeft > 0 ? `ongoing for ${daysLeft} more days` : `ending today`;
        calText += `${e.name} ${status}\n`;
      }
    });

    // Append countdowns
    upcomingEvents.forEach(e => {
      let prefix = e.announce ? "Announcement: " : "";
      let timeStr = e.diff === 1 ? "tomorrow" : `in ${e.diff} days`;
      calText += `${prefix}${e.name} ${timeStr}\n`;
    });

    // Format text with ## prefix on every line
    let formattedText = calText.trim().split('\n').map(line => `## ${line}`).join('\n');

// 5. Purge old Calendar, Curriculum, and Character cards to prevent clutter
    for (let i = storyCards.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const title = storyCards[i].title;
      if (
        title === "🗓️ Calendar" || title === "Calendar"
      ) {
        storyCards.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // 6. Inject Fresh Cards into Memory
    // Inject Calendar (Index 0)
    constructCard({
      type: "Calendar",
      title: "🗓️ Calendar",
      keys: "You,?,.,!",
      entry: formattedText,
      description: `In case you forget, there are a few things to keep in mind:
🌙 Progress: Ready for the next day? Just type 'pass the day' or 'end the day' when you're at home or not in the middle of a conversation/scene!
⏩ Secret Time Skip Easter Egg: Type 'go into autopilot' to skip forward 3 days. Warning: Do not use during the first week (before April 18). Use at your own risk.
🗓️ Calendar: Check your Calendar in Story Cards regularly! It automatically updates everyday with school curriculum, upcoming events, and more!
‼️ Important: Please, absolutely make sure Optimized Context is disabled! You can find it in Gameplay settings (if it doesn't appear, it's OK)!`
    }, 0); 

    delete state.triggerCalendarUpdate;
  }

  return { text };

// Constructs a new story card from a standardized template object
function constructCard(templateCard, insertionIndex = 0) {
  addStoryCard("%@%");
  for (const [index, card] of storyCards.entries()) {
    if (card.title !== "%@%") continue;
    
    card.type = templateCard.type;
    card.title = templateCard.title;
    card.keys = templateCard.keys;
    card.entry = templateCard.entry;
    card.description = templateCard.description;
    
    if (index !== insertionIndex) {
      storyCards.splice(index, 1);
      storyCards.splice(insertionIndex, 0, card);
    }
    return Object.seal(card);
  }
  return {}; 
}
